scenarios.name: Inspect projects from the template chooser

scenario_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/assembly-template-fixture.opj` as its active project
the user opens the new-document template chooser
the user selects the `Standard (mm)` assembly template and displays its details
the user chooses Projects in the chooser
a Projects dialog opens above the chooser
the fixture project name and location are listed
the fixture project is marked as active
the dialog displays a project settings tree
the user chooses Done without changing the project
the template chooser is displayed again
the previously selected template details remain displayed
